_doc: Whether a call to an agent is the agent's own call (the dashboard's Call <agent> label, GET /api/agents/:id/settings agent_calls). Both sides run every case: the API (api/src/lib/agentCallGate.ts) and the voice side (services/arturo/agent_call.py enabled(seat), on the relay engine; scripts/test_agent_call_gate.py). True only when all hold: switch_on (<data dir>/state/agent-calls.json seats.<id>.on is exactly true); headless (switched on in headless-seats.json with runtime claude, and the registry row's runtime, if it has one, is claude); engine is relay (GPT-Live: Arturo's /health live_engine; the Gemini engine never reaches the agent's session). Dev does not change it: in Dev the call stays the agent's, and each turn asks the person to tap Back to chat (settings in_dev says so).
